summary.text: Susan Elberger is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Hillsborough 5, where she assumed office on December 7, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A mental health counselor and small business owner, she serves on the House Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Susan Elberger earned a B.A. in sociology and psychology and an M.A., Ed.S. in counseling and personnel services, both from the State University of New York at Albany.
Her career experience includes working as a mental health counselor and small business owner.
She has volunteered as a member of the Lexington School Committee and the Lexington Town Meeting.
Elberger's 2023-2024 committee assignment was the House Ways and Means Committee.
